$comment: THE IMMUTABLE REFERENCE. This file is the voice, written down.
neural is the default voice of the DeltaVerse, on every page and after every
refresh, and it is not edited — only derived from. That is not a restriction
for its own sake: a reader who has heard the realm speak once should hear the
same voice next time, whatever anyone has been auditioning. An audition is not
a preference, which is why the player deliberately does NOT restore the last
NOTE WHAT IS ABSENT. There is no length_scale, no rate multiplier, no pitch
multiplier on the rendered side. The renderer invokes piper with NO scaling
flag at all. A neutral parameter is still a parameter: 1.0 today is 0.98 the
day someone decides the reference reads a little fast. The reference has no
Two engines, one voice. `rendered` is what a browser plays when the audio
store has this page; `live` is what the browser's own synthesiser is asked
for when it does not. They are different machines and cannot be made
identical — the live entry is a selection rule over whatever voices the
platform happens to have, and it says so.
name: Neural
character: the realm's own voice — the reference every other voice is derived from

rendered.$flags: empty ON PURPOSE — see the note above; render_neural.py passes none
rendered.$measured: measured on a 2-vCPU host, not quoted from upstream. piper is non-deterministic (noise_scale 0.667, noise_w 0.8), so two renders of one sentence differ byte for byte; compare durations, never checksums.

live.$prefer: ordered, first match wins, matched case-insensitively against the platform's own voice names — so the best voice actually PRESENT is used rather than a name that may not exist

derivations.$comment: a derivation stores a RATIO, never an absolute, so improving the reference improves everything measured against it

ovie.character: the ollywoo director — quicker and brighter

participant.$note: x1.00/x1.00 IS neural under a second name; it measures identically (f0 94.6 Hz) and that is an open question, not a finding

notDerivedFromThis.$comment: voices that are NOT ratios on neural, and cannot be
notDerivedFromThis.jaimla: saved in her own right. Pitch is not gender: lowering a male voice produces a larger man, not a woman. Female by SELECTION — en_GB-jenny_dioco-medium rendered (f0 183.8 Hz), a named female platform voice live.
notDerivedFromThis.overlord: its own voice — en-earth+overlord, LEADER's mass with ANCIENT's refusal to raise a syllable, plus a calibrated octave underneath (f0 81.1 Hz).
